title: La vuelta al mundo de un novelista; vol. 3/3
summary: "La vuelta al mundo de un novelista; vol. 3/3" by Vicente Blasco Ibáñez is a travel narrative published between 1924 and 1925. The Spanish writer chronicles his journey around the world aboard the Cunard cruise ship Franconia from November 1923 to March 1924. This third volume covers his travels through India, Ceylon, Sudan, Nubia, and Egypt. Blasco weaves historical, geographical, cultural, and political observations about the interwar period, offering reflections that remain compelling a century later.
